SELECT
  h.`Company Code`,
  h.`Billing Date`,
  h.`Document Currency`,
  h.`Statistics Currency`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT li.`Billing Document Number`) as num_invoices,
  SUM(li.`Net Value`) as net_value_doc_currency,
  SUM(li.`NET Value in Statistical Currency`) as net_value_stat_currency,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN h.`Document Currency` = 'EUR' THEN li.`Net Value`
      WHEN h.`Statistics Currency` = 'EUR' THEN li.`NET Value in Statistical Currency`
      ELSE li.`Net Value` * COALESCE(h.`Exchange Rate Accntg`, 1)
    END
  ) as total_invoiced_value_eur
FROM
  `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_billing_document_header h
    JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item li
      ON h.`Billing Document Header Key` = li.`Billing Document Header Key`
WHERE
  h.`Company Code` IN ('6700', '6740', '6760')
  AND h.`Billing Date` >= date_sub(current_date(), 10)
  AND COALESCE(li.`Cancelled Indicator Flag`, '') != 'X'
  AND COALESCE(li.`Cancelled Data Record Indicator Flag`, '') != 'X'
GROUP BY
  h.`Company Code`,
  h.`Billing Date`,
  h.`Document Currency`,
  h.`Statistics Currency`
ORDER BY
  h.`Company Code`,
  h.`Billing Date`

WITH ursa_plants AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM VALUES
    ('6701', 'SK DK (6700)', '6700', '6701 - Skamol Fur (Prod)', 1),
    ('6702', 'SK DK (6700)', '6700', '6702 - Skamol Branden (Prod)', 0),

    ('6741', 'SK PL (6740)', '6740', '6741 - Skamol Opole (Prod)', 1),
    ('6761', 'SK EE (6760)', '6760', '6761 - Skamol Sosnowiec (Prod)', 1),
    ('6901', 'SK APAC (6900)', '6900', '6901 - Skamol Mulgrave (WH)', 1),
    ('6902', 'SK APAC (6900)', '6900', '6902 - Skamol Melbourne (WH)', 0),
    ('6904', 'SK APAC (6900)', '6900', '6904 - Skamol Perth (WH)', 0)
    AS t(plant_code, country_name, company_code, plant_label, is_primary_for_cc)
),
date_spine AS (
  SELECT explode(sequence(date_sub(current_date(), 6), current_date(), interval 1 day)) AS snapshot_date
),
plant_key_map AS (
  SELECT
    p.`Plant Key`,
    CAST(p.`Plant Code` AS STRING) AS plant_code,
    u.country_name,
    u.company_code,
    u.plant_label
  FROM `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_dim_plant p
  INNER JOIN ursa_plants u ON CAST(p.`Plant Code` AS STRING) = u.plant_code
),
company_key_map AS (
  SELECT
    c.`Company Key`,
    CAST(c.`Company Code` AS STRING) AS company_code,
    u.country_name,
    u.plant_label
  FROM `synapse-prd`.pbi.company c
  INNER JOIN ursa_plants u
    ON CAST(c.`Company Code` AS STRING) = u.company_code
    AND u.is_primary_for_cc = 1
),
kpi_master AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM VALUES
    ('Order to Cash', '# of Sales Order Not entered (Backlog)', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# of Sales Order created', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open sales order items missing outbound delivery', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open sales order items with outbound, but missing shipment', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open Sales order Items with Delivery block', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open Sales order Items with billing block', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Customer invoices to be sent', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# of Customer Invoices issued', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Order to Cash', 'Total Invoiced Value (€)', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# of Pos created', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# of Pos pending approval', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Invoices in AP Processing in VIM (not paid)', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Invoice Approvals Missing', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Invoices without GR', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Overdue Invoices', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Vendor invoices received', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Production Planning', 'Planned Production Orders not converted', 'LOWER'),
    ('Production Planning', 'Production order backlog (overdue orders not scheduled)', 'LOWER'),
    ('Production Planning', '# daily production order confirmations', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Production Planning', '# Production orders not closed with passed Finish date', 'LOWER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of picking warehouse tasks', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of putaway warehouse tasks', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of goods receipts', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of shipments completed', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# of Journal entries posted', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# of payment transactions', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# Materials not created', 'LOWER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# MTO / MTS Concistency check: incorrect materials', 'LOWER')
    AS t(kpi_stream, kpi_name, direction)
),
master_spine AS (
  SELECT
    m.kpi_stream, m.kpi_name, m.direction,
    u.country_name, u.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
  FROM ursa_plants u
  CROSS JOIN date_spine d
  CROSS JOIN kpi_master m
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 1: ORDER TO CASH
-- ============================================================================
kpi_backlog AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Sales Order Not entered (Backlog)' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.`Sales Document Item`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item o
    ON to_date(CAST(o.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON o.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(o.`Order Status`, '') NOT IN ('C')
    AND COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''
    AND o.`Measure Required Delivery Quantity` > 0
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_sales_orders AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Sales Order created' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.`Sales Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item o
    ON to_date(CAST(o.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON o.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(o.`Document Category`, '') NOT IN ('B')
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_missing_delivery AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open sales order items missing outbound delivery' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.`Sales Document Item`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item o
    ON to_date(CAST(o.`Requested Delivery Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
       BETWEEN d.snapshot_date AND date_add(d.snapshot_date, 7)
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON o.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(o.`Order Status`, '') NOT IN ('C')
    AND COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_missing_pgi AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open sales order items with outbound, but missing shipment' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
       BETWEEN d.snapshot_date AND date_add(d.snapshot_date, 7)
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE (COALESCE(dh.`Goods Movement Status`, '') <> 'C'
         OR dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` IS NULL
         OR dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` = 0)
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_delivery_block AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open Sales order Items with Delivery block' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Delivery Block`, '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Overall Delivery Status`, '') <> 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_billing_block AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open Sales order Items with billing block' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Billing Block`, '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Order Related Bill Status`, '') <> 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_invoices_to_be_sent AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Customer invoices to be sent' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dh.`Delivery Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Goods Movement Status`, '') = 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Billing Block`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Order Related Bill Status`, '') NOT IN ('C', '')
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_invoices_issued AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Customer Invoices issued' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.`Billing Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item b
    ON to_date(CAST(b.`Billing Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON b.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON b.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(b.`Cancelled Indicator Flag`, '') <> 'X'
    AND COALESCE(b.`Posting Status Indicator Flag`, '') = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_invoiced_value AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    'Total Invoiced Value (€)' AS kpi_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.`NET Value in Statistical Currency`, 0)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item b
    ON to_date(CAST(b.`Billing Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON b.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON b.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(b.`Cancelled Indicator Flag`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 2: PROCURE TO PAY
-- ============================================================================
kpi_pos_created AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Pos created' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT po.`Purchasing Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_purchasing_document_summary po
    ON to_date(CAST(po.`Purchase Order Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON po.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON po.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(po.`Purchasing Doc type`, '') IN ('F', 'NB', 'YNB', 'UB', 'FO', 'YMAV')
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator header`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator item`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pos_pending_approval AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Pos pending approval' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT po.`Purchasing Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_purchasing_document_summary po
    ON to_date(CAST(po.`Purchase Order Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON po.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON po.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator header`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator item`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(po.`Release Indicator`, '') NOT IN ('R', '')
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_ap_not_paid AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Invoices in AP Processing in VIM (not paid)' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.`Invoice Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_accounts_payable ap
    ON ap.`Date Posting` <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ap.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(ap.`Clearing Document Number`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_vim_approvals_missing AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Invoice Approvals Missing' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.`Document ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_vim_document_header v
    ON v.`Doc Date` <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON v.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE v.`Doc Status` = '11'  -- 11 = Awaiting Approval
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_vim_without_gr AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Invoices without GR' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.`Document ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_vim_document_header v
    ON v.`Doc Date` <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON v.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE v.`Doc Status` IN ('02', '03', '04', '14', '18')
    -- 02=Indexed, 03=Sent for Doc Creation, 04=Document Created,
    -- 14=Parked, 18=Blocked — invoices received but GR not yet done
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_ap_overdue AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Overdue Invoices' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.`Invoice Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_accounts_payable ap
    ON ap.`Date Due Date Calculation` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ap.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(ap.`Clearing Document Number`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_vendor_invoices_received AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Vendor invoices received' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.`Document ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_vim_document_header v
    ON v.`Doc Date` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON v.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 3: PRODUCTION PLANNING
-- Note: PP tables have NO Skamol data — these will return 0 for now.
-- They will populate when URSA company codes are used at go-live.
-- ============================================================================
kpi_pp_not_converted AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    'Planned Production Orders not converted' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.`Production Order ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_pp_order_headers pp
    ON pp.`Scheduled Start Date` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pp.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE pp.`Actual Release Date` = DATE '1970-01-01'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pp_backlog AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    'Production order backlog (overdue orders not scheduled)' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.`Production Order ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_pp_order_headers pp
    ON pp.`Scheduled Finish Date` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pp.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE pp.`Actual Finish Date` = DATE '1970-01-01'
    AND pp.`Scheduled Finish Date` <> DATE '1970-01-01'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pp_confirmations AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# daily production order confirmations' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.`Production Order ID (Order Confirmations)`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_pp_order_confirmations pc
    ON pc.`Posting Date` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pc.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pp_not_closed AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Production orders not closed with passed Finish date' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.`Production Order ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_pp_order_headers pp
    ON pp.`Basic Finish Date` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pp.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE pp.`Actual Finish Date` = DATE '1970-01-01'
    AND pp.`Basic Finish Date` <> DATE '1970-01-01'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 4: WAREHOUSE AND LOGISTICS
-- ============================================================================
kpi_wm_picking AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of picking warehouse tasks' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Picking Status`, '') = 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_wm_putaway AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of putaway warehouse tasks' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.`Material Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_stock_movements sm
    ON to_date(CAST(sm.`Posting Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_dim_inventory_movement_type mt
    ON sm.`Inventory Movement Type Key` = mt.`Inventory Movement Type Key`
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON sm.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE mt.`Inventory Movement Type Code` IN ('311', '315', '321')
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_mm_goods_receipts AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of goods receipts' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.`Material Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_stock_movements sm
    ON to_date(CAST(sm.`Posting Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_dim_inventory_movement_type mt
    ON sm.`Inventory Movement Type Key` = mt.`Inventory Movement Type Key`
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON sm.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE mt.`Inventory Movement Type Code` IN ('101', '131', '501')
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_wm_shipments AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of shipments completed' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dh.`Delivery Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Goods Movement Status`, '') = 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 5: FINANCE AND GOVERNANCE
-- ============================================================================
kpi_fi_journals AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Journal entries posted' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ac.`Accounting Document`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_accounting_document_item ac
    ON ac.`Date Posting` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ac.`Company Code` = ck.company_code
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_fi_payments AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of payment transactions' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.`Invoice Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_fact_accounts_payable ap
    ON ap.`Date Posting` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ap.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE ap.`Accounting Document Type` IN ('ZP', 'ZB')
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_md_materials_not_created AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Materials not created' AS kpi_name,
    0 AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT country_name, plant_label FROM plant_key_map) pk
),
kpi_md_mto_mts_check AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# MTO / MTS Concistency check: incorrect materials' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.`Material Plant Key`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  CROSS JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.dbx_dim_material_plant mp
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON mp.`Plant Id` = pk.plant_code
  WHERE COALESCE(mp.`Mrp Type`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- UNION ALL 28 KPIS
-- ============================================================================
daily_kpis AS (
  SELECT 'Order to Cash' AS kpi_stream, * FROM kpi_backlog
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_sales_orders
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_missing_delivery
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_missing_pgi
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_delivery_block
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_billing_block
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_invoices_to_be_sent
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_invoices_issued
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_invoiced_value
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_pos_created
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_pos_pending_approval
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_ap_not_paid
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_vim_approvals_missing
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_vim_without_gr
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_ap_overdue
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_vendor_invoices_received
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_not_converted
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_backlog
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_confirmations
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_not_closed
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_wm_picking
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_wm_putaway
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_mm_goods_receipts
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_wm_shipments
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_fi_journals
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_fi_payments
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_md_materials_not_created
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_md_mto_mts_check
),
final_merged AS (
  SELECT
    s.kpi_stream, s.kpi_name, s.direction,
    s.country_name, s.plant_label, s.snapshot_date,
    COALESCE(c.actual_value, 0) AS actual_value
  FROM master_spine s
  LEFT JOIN daily_kpis c
    ON s.kpi_stream = c.kpi_stream
    AND s.kpi_name = c.kpi_name
    AND s.country_name = c.country_name
    AND s.plant_label = c.plant_label
    AND s.snapshot_date = c.snapshot_date
),
with_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    kpi_stream, kpi_name, direction,
    country_name, plant_label, snapshot_date,
    actual_value,
    0.0 AS baseline_val
  FROM final_merged
)
SELECT
  kpi_stream, kpi_name,
  country_name, plant_label,
  FORMAT_NUMBER(baseline_val, 0) AS baseline,
  snapshot_date,
  actual_value,
  CASE
    WHEN actual_value = 0 THEN '● NM'
    WHEN direction = 'HIGHER' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN actual_value >= baseline_val THEN CONCAT('▲ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
        ELSE CONCAT('▼ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
      END
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN actual_value <= baseline_val THEN CONCAT('▲ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
        ELSE CONCAT('▼ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
      END
  END AS formatted_cell
FROM with_baseline
ORDER BY kpi_stream, kpi_name, country_name, plant_label, snapshot_date

WITH ursa_plants AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM VALUES
    ('6701', 'SK DK (6700)', '6700', '6701 - Skamol Fur (Prod)', 1),
    ('6702', 'SK DK (6700)', '6700', '6702 - Skamol Branden (Prod)', 0),
    ('6703', 'SK DK (6700)', '6700', '6703 - Skamol Roedding (Prod)', 0),
    ('6741', 'SK PL (6740)', '6740', '6741 - Skamol Opole (Prod)', 1),
    ('6761', 'SK EE (6760)', '6760', '6761 - Skamol Sosnowiec (Prod)', 1),
    ('6901', 'SK APAC (6900)', '6900', '6901 - Skamol Mulgrave (WH)', 1),
    ('6902', 'SK APAC (6900)', '6900', '6902 - Skamol Melbourne (WH)', 0),
    ('6904', 'SK APAC (6900)', '6900', '6904 - Skamol Perth (WH)', 0)
    AS t(plant_code, country_name, company_code, plant_label, is_primary_for_cc)
),
date_spine AS (
  SELECT explode(sequence(date_sub(current_date(), 6), current_date(), interval 1 day)) AS snapshot_date
),
plant_key_map AS (
  SELECT
    p.`Plant Key`,
    CAST(p.`Plant Code` AS STRING) AS plant_code,
    u.country_name,
    u.company_code,
    u.plant_label
  FROM `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_dim_plant` p
  INNER JOIN ursa_plants u ON CAST(p.`Plant Code` AS STRING) = u.plant_code
),
company_key_map AS (
  SELECT
    c.`Company Key`,
    CAST(c.`Company Code` AS STRING) AS company_code,
    u.country_name,
    u.plant_label
  FROM `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_company` c
  INNER JOIN ursa_plants u
    ON CAST(c.`Company Code` AS STRING) = u.company_code
    AND u.is_primary_for_cc = 1
),
kpi_master AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM VALUES
    ('Order to Cash', '# of Sales Order Not entered (Backlog)', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# of Sales Order created', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open sales order items missing outbound delivery', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open sales order items with outbound, but missing shipment', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open Sales order Items with Delivery block', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Open Sales order Items with billing block', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# Customer invoices to be sent', 'LOWER'),
    ('Order to Cash', '# of Customer Invoices issued', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Order to Cash', 'Total Invoiced Value (€)', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# of Pos created', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# of Pos pending approval', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Invoices in AP Processing in VIM (not paid)', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Invoice Approvals Missing', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Invoices without GR', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Overdue Invoices', 'LOWER'),
    ('Procure to Pay', '# Vendor invoices received', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Production Planning', 'Planned Production Orders not converted', 'LOWER'),
    ('Production Planning', 'Production order backlog (overdue orders not scheduled)', 'LOWER'),
    ('Production Planning', '# daily production order confirmations', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Production Planning', '# Production orders not closed with passed Finish date', 'LOWER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of picking warehouse tasks', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of putaway warehouse tasks', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of goods receipts', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Warehouse and Logistics', '# of shipments completed', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# of Journal entries posted', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# of payment transactions', 'HIGHER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# Materials not created', 'LOWER'),
    ('Finance and Governance', '# MTO / MTS Concistency check: incorrect materials', 'LOWER')
    AS t(kpi_stream, kpi_name, direction)
),
master_spine AS (
  SELECT
    m.kpi_stream, m.kpi_name, m.direction,
    u.country_name, u.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
  FROM ursa_plants u
  CROSS JOIN date_spine d
  CROSS JOIN kpi_master m
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 1: ORDER TO CASH
-- ============================================================================
kpi_backlog AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Sales Order Not entered (Backlog)' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.`Sales Document Item`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` o
    ON to_date(CAST(o.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON o.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(o.`Order Status`, '') NOT IN ('C')
    AND COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''
    AND o.`Measure Required Delivery Quantity` > 0
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_sales_orders AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Sales Order created' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.`Sales Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` o
    ON to_date(CAST(o.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON o.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(o.`Document Category`, '') NOT IN ('B')
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_missing_delivery AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open sales order items missing outbound delivery' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.`Sales Document Item`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` o
    ON to_date(CAST(o.`Requested Delivery Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
       BETWEEN d.snapshot_date AND date_add(d.snapshot_date, 7)
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON o.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(o.`Order Status`, '') NOT IN ('C')
    AND COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_missing_pgi AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open sales order items with outbound, but missing shipment' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview` dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
       BETWEEN d.snapshot_date AND date_add(d.snapshot_date, 7)
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE (COALESCE(dh.`Goods Movement Status`, '') <> 'C'
         OR dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` IS NULL
         OR dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` = 0)
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_delivery_block AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open Sales order Items with Delivery block' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview` dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Delivery Block`, '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Overall Delivery Status`, '') <> 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_billing_block AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Open Sales order Items with billing block' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview` dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Billing Block`, '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Order Related Bill Status`, '') <> 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_invoices_to_be_sent AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Customer invoices to be sent' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dh.`Delivery Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview` dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Goods Movement Status`, '') = 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Billing Block`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Order Related Bill Status`, '') NOT IN ('C', '')
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_invoices_issued AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Customer Invoices issued' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.`Billing Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b
    ON to_date(CAST(b.`Billing Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON b.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON b.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(b.`Cancelled Indicator Flag`, '') <> 'X'
    AND COALESCE(b.`Posting Status Indicator Flag`, '') = 'C'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_invoiced_value AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    'Total Invoiced Value (€)' AS kpi_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.`NET Value in Statistical Currency`, 0)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b
    ON to_date(CAST(b.`Billing Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON b.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON b.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(b.`Cancelled Indicator Flag`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 2: PROCURE TO PAY
-- ============================================================================
kpi_pos_created AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Pos created' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT po.`Purchasing Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_purchasing_document_summary` po
    ON to_date(CAST(po.`Purchase Order Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON po.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON po.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(po.`Purchasing Doc type`, '') IN ('F', 'NB', 'YNB', 'UB', 'FO', 'YMAV')
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator header`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator item`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pos_pending_approval AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name) AS country_name,
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label) AS plant_label,
    d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Pos pending approval' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT po.`Purchasing Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_purchasing_document_summary` po
    ON to_date(CAST(po.`Purchase Order Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= d.snapshot_date
  LEFT JOIN plant_key_map pk ON po.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  LEFT JOIN company_key_map ck ON po.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE (pk.`Plant Key` IS NOT NULL OR ck.`Company Key` IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator header`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(po.`Flag Deletion Indicator item`, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(po.`Release Indicator`, '') NOT IN ('R', '')
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pk.country_name, ck.country_name),
    COALESCE(pk.plant_label, ck.plant_label),
    d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_ap_not_paid AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Invoices in AP Processing in VIM (not paid)' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.`Invoice Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_accounts_payable` ap
    ON ap.`Date Posting` <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ap.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(ap.`Clearing Document Number`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_vim_approvals_missing AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Invoice Approvals Missing' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.`Document ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_vim_document_header` v
    ON v.`Doc Date` <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON v.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE v.`Doc Status` = '11'  -- 11 = Awaiting Approval
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_vim_without_gr AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Invoices without GR' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.`Document ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_vim_document_header` v
    ON v.`Doc Date` <= d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON v.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE v.`Doc Status` IN ('02', '03', '04', '14', '18')
    -- 02=Indexed, 03=Sent for Doc Creation, 04=Document Created,
    -- 14=Parked, 18=Blocked — invoices received but GR not yet done
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_ap_overdue AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Overdue Invoices' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.`Invoice Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_accounts_payable` ap
    ON ap.`Date Due Date Calculation` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ap.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(ap.`Clearing Document Number`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_vendor_invoices_received AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Vendor invoices received' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.`Document ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_vim_document_header` v
    ON v.`Doc Date` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON v.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 3: PRODUCTION PLANNING
-- Note: PP tables have NO Skamol data — these will return 0 for now.
-- They will populate when URSA company codes are used at go-live.
-- ============================================================================
kpi_pp_not_converted AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    'Planned Production Orders not converted' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.`Production Order ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_pp_order_headers` pp
    ON pp.`Scheduled Start Date` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pp.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE pp.`Actual Release Date` = DATE '1970-01-01'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pp_backlog AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    'Production order backlog (overdue orders not scheduled)' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.`Production Order ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_pp_order_headers` pp
    ON pp.`Scheduled Finish Date` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pp.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE pp.`Actual Finish Date` = DATE '1970-01-01'
    AND pp.`Scheduled Finish Date` <> DATE '1970-01-01'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pp_confirmations AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# daily production order confirmations' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.`Production Order ID (Order Confirmations)`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_pp_order_confirmations` pc
    ON pc.`Posting Date` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pc.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_pp_not_closed AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Production orders not closed with passed Finish date' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.`Production Order ID`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_pp_order_headers` pp
    ON pp.`Basic Finish Date` < d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON pp.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE pp.`Actual Finish Date` = DATE '1970-01-01'
    AND pp.`Basic Finish Date` <> DATE '1970-01-01'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 4: WAREHOUSE AND LOGISTICS
-- ============================================================================
kpi_wm_picking AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of picking warehouse tasks' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dh.`Delivery Document Number`, '-', dh.`Delivery Document Item Number`)) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview` dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Planned Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Picking Status`, '') = 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_wm_putaway AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of putaway warehouse tasks' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.`Material Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_stock_movements` sm
    ON to_date(CAST(sm.`Posting Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_dim_inventory_movement_type` mt
    ON sm.`Inventory Movement Type Key` = mt.`Inventory Movement Type Key`
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON sm.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE mt.`Inventory Movement Type Code` IN ('311', '315', '321')
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_mm_goods_receipts AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of goods receipts' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.`Material Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_stock_movements` sm
    ON to_date(CAST(sm.`Posting Date Key` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_dim_inventory_movement_type` mt
    ON sm.`Inventory Movement Type Key` = mt.`Inventory Movement Type Key`
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON sm.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE mt.`Inventory Movement Type Code` IN ('101', '131', '501')
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_wm_shipments AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of shipments completed' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dh.`Delivery Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_overview` dh
    ON to_date(CAST(dh.`Actual Goods Movement Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON dh.`Plant Key` = pk.`Plant Key`
  WHERE COALESCE(dh.`Goods Movement Status`, '') = 'C'
    AND COALESCE(dh.`Cancel Data Record`, '') <> 'X'
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- CATEGORY 5: FINANCE AND GOVERNANCE
-- ============================================================================
kpi_fi_journals AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of Journal entries posted' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ac.`Accounting Document`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_accounting_document_item` ac
    ON ac.`Date Posting` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ac.`Company Code` = ck.company_code
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_fi_payments AS (
  SELECT
    ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# of payment transactions' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.`Invoice Document Number`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_fact_accounts_payable` ap
    ON ap.`Date Posting` = d.snapshot_date
  INNER JOIN company_key_map ck ON ap.`Company Key` = ck.`Company Key`
  WHERE ap.`Accounting Document Type` IN ('ZP', 'ZB')
  GROUP BY ck.country_name, ck.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),
kpi_md_materials_not_created AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# Materials not created' AS kpi_name,
    0 AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT country_name, plant_label FROM plant_key_map) pk
),
kpi_md_mto_mts_check AS (
  SELECT
    pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date,
    '# MTO / MTS Concistency check: incorrect materials' AS kpi_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.`Material Plant Key`) AS actual_value
  FROM date_spine d
  CROSS JOIN `URSA_KPI_input_source_pbi_dbx_dim_material_plant` mp
  INNER JOIN plant_key_map pk ON mp.`Plant Id` = pk.plant_code
  WHERE COALESCE(mp.`Mrp Type`, '') = ''
  GROUP BY pk.country_name, pk.plant_label, d.snapshot_date
),

-- ============================================================================
-- UNION ALL 28 KPIS
-- ============================================================================
daily_kpis AS (
  SELECT 'Order to Cash' AS kpi_stream, * FROM kpi_backlog
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_sales_orders
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_missing_delivery
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_missing_pgi
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_delivery_block
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_billing_block
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_invoices_to_be_sent
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_invoices_issued
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Order to Cash', * FROM kpi_invoiced_value
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_pos_created
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_pos_pending_approval
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_ap_not_paid
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_vim_approvals_missing
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_vim_without_gr
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_ap_overdue
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Procure to Pay', * FROM kpi_vendor_invoices_received
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_not_converted
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_backlog
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_confirmations
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Production Planning', * FROM kpi_pp_not_closed
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_wm_picking
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_wm_putaway
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_mm_goods_receipts
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Warehouse and Logistics', * FROM kpi_wm_shipments
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_fi_journals
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_fi_payments
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_md_materials_not_created
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance and Governance', * FROM kpi_md_mto_mts_check
),
final_merged AS (
  SELECT
    s.kpi_stream, s.kpi_name, s.direction,
    s.country_name, s.plant_label, s.snapshot_date,
    COALESCE(c.actual_value, 0) AS actual_value
  FROM master_spine s
  LEFT JOIN daily_kpis c
    ON s.kpi_stream = c.kpi_stream
    AND s.kpi_name = c.kpi_name
    AND s.country_name = c.country_name
    AND s.plant_label = c.plant_label
    AND s.snapshot_date = c.snapshot_date
),
with_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    kpi_stream, kpi_name, direction,
    country_name, plant_label, snapshot_date,
    actual_value,
    0.0 AS baseline_val
  FROM final_merged
)
SELECT
  kpi_stream, kpi_name,
  country_name, plant_label,
  FORMAT_NUMBER(baseline_val, 0) AS baseline,
  snapshot_date,
  actual_value,
  CASE
    WHEN actual_value = 0 THEN '● NM'
    WHEN direction = 'HIGHER' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN actual_value >= baseline_val THEN CONCAT('▲ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
        ELSE CONCAT('▼ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
      END
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN actual_value <= baseline_val THEN CONCAT('▲ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
        ELSE CONCAT('▼ ', FORMAT_NUMBER(actual_value, 0))
      END
  END AS formatted_cell
FROM with_baseline
ORDER BY kpi_stream, kpi_name, country_name, plant_label, snapshot_date
